about: Motherboard database: chipset families (matched on the board model), vendors (BIOS menu names), and specific models.

families.name: Intel Z890
tips: Core Ultra 200S K chips: Intel 200S Boost profile is available here (latest BIOS).

families.name: Intel B860 / H810
tips: Memory overclocking (XMP) is supported on B860; CPU ratio overclocking is not.

families.name: Intel Z790 / Z690
tips: 13th/14th gen: install a BIOS with microcode 0x12B or newer and choose Intel Default Settings.

families.name: Intel B760 / B660 / H770 / H670
tips: XMP works; CPU ratio overclocking does not.
13th/14th gen: install a BIOS with microcode 0x12B or newer.

families.name: Intel H610
tips: H610 runs memory at JEDEC speed only: a faster kit will not help here.

families.name: Intel 500 / 400 series
tips: Z: full overclocking. B560: memory OC allowed. B460/H-series: memory capped by the CPU (2666/2933).

families.name: Intel 300 series
tips: Z370/Z390: full overclocking; B360/H310: memory capped at 2666.

families.name: AMD AM5 (X870 / B850 / X670 / B650 / A620)
tips: Keep the BIOS updated: newer AGESA improves memory, X3D support and caps SoC voltage at 1.3 V.
Enable EXPO and 'Memory Context Restore' for fast boots.
A620 / B840: limited or no CPU overclocking; EXPO still works.

families.name: AMD AM4 (X570 / B550 / A520 / X470 / B450 / X370 / B350 / A320)
tips: Ryzen 5000 on 300/400 boards needs a BIOS update first (check the CPU support list).
A320/A520: no CPU overclocking; memory profiles still work.

menus.xmp: Ai Tweaker > Ai Overclock Tuner > XMP / EXPO
menus.rebar: Advanced > PCI Subsystem Settings > Above 4G Decoding + Re-Size BAR
menus.pbo: Advanced > AMD Overclocking > Precision Boost Overdrive

menus.xmp: OC > Extreme Memory Profile (XMP/EXPO), or EZ Mode button
menus.rebar: Settings > Advanced > PCIe/PCI Sub-system Settings > Re-Size BAR Support
menus.pbo: OC > Advanced CPU Configuration > AMD Overclocking > PBO (X3D: Kombo Strike)

menus.rebar: Settings > IO Ports > Above 4G Decoding + Re-Size BAR Support
menus.pbo: Tweaker > Advanced CPU Settings > Precision Boost Overdrive

menus.xmp: OC Tweaker > DRAM Configuration > Load XMP / EXPO Setting
menus.rebar: Advanced > Chipset Configuration > Above 4G Decoding + Re-Size BAR Support
menus.pbo: Advanced > AMD Overclocking > Precision Boost Overdrive

menus.xmp: Often not offered: prebuilt BIOSes usually lock memory speed
menus.rebar: Usually on by default in recent models
menus.fans: Vendor app (Alienware Command Center, OMEN Gaming Hub, Lenovo Vantage)

models.name: ASRock B760M Pro RS
notes: This board does not report memory voltage to Windows sensors; GearShift reads it from the BIOS tables instead.
Get BIOS updates from ASRock's support page; 13th/14th gen need the 0x12B+ microcode versions.
